apps.name: AirMaraud
apps.tagline: 2.4 GHz deauth lab via WIFIPROOF: scan targets, arm to TX one frame
apps.description: Authorized 2.4 GHz assessment tool on Bottlenose ESP32-C6 via WIFIPROOF UART. Main CPU carries the display image and C6 firmware. On the display: scan in-scope APs and clients, arm a target for deauth/disassoc TX.
apps.author: Intrepid Control Systems
